structure:
Part 12 read the ten INS address-book specs that read the book rather than change a record, the three helpers beside them, and the page objects, constants, flows, fixtures and tools they lean on, all in full at repos/trade-imports-ins-tests HEAD c433e6b (tag 0.152.0).

Specs, with what each proves:
- address-book-list.spec.ts (19 tests, 3 of them without JavaScript): intro, Add a new address, the Filter addresses disclosure, search by button and by Enter, the no-match state, Clear search, a dashboard-to-delete walk-through, 8 a page, five-page pagination, search on address line 2, county, name, address and country, the Name and Address cell layout, newest first, the add and edit success banners.
- address-book-tabs.spec.ts (7 tests: 2 API, 4 browser, 1 without JavaScript): the three tabs, the default and unknown-tab fallback, each tab's panel heading, columns and rows, the Transporter tab's columns, every seeded fixture on its tab.
- address-book-role-filter.spec.ts (12 tests: 2 API, 9 browser, 1 without JavaScript): the Type filter's options per tab, server-side filtering on submit only, counts and paging under a filter, filter state across pages and tabs, searching by a role's name, the API's role and searchRole.
- address-book-transporter-type-filter.spec.ts (2 tests): the Transporter tab's options and a Commercial filter.
- address-book-roles.spec.ts (12 tests, all API): the five roles read back, kept order, replaced on update, the seven refusals, and abroad addresses in each of the two groups.
- address-book-country-list.spec.ts (3 tests, compose stack only): the add forms' and edit form's Country select.
- address-book-seed.spec.ts (1 test): seeding is idempotent.
- address-book-cross-user-visibility.spec.ts (1 test), address-book-auth.spec.ts (2 tests), address-book-persistence.spec.ts (1 test, compose stack only).

Helpers: expect-address-book-list.ts (list landing, link order, no-match state), expect-other-organisation-address-returns-to-list.ts (another organisation's record returns the user to the list), run-addresses.ts (the three addresses a tab or role-filter test adds).

Supporting files read: the list, record, transporter view and url-with-return page objects, page-objects/ins/index.ts, base-page.ts, summary-list.ts, opens-at-expected-url.ts; the address-book-types, address-book-journey, transporter-types, trader-address, trader-transporter and address-details constants; address-types.ts and test-record-names.ts; the address document model; flows/ins/journey.ts and flows/shared/address-book-seed.ts; fixtures/ui.ts and auth-state.ts; utils/address-book-cleanup.ts and roles-options-assertions.ts; config/users.ts; bin/reset-e2e-address-book.ts. Three files outside the read list were opened only to resolve values: expected-api-refusal.ts, journey-party-names.ts and address-picker-results.ts.

What changed since the earlier extract: the Branch address type, tab, role and its two seeded records are gone. The suite now has three tabs, five roles in two groups (sending and receiving), twelve seeded records, and a test proving BRANCH_ADDRESS is refused as an unknown role. Claims that named four tabs, six roles, three groups or fourteen records were replaced under new ids; the rest keep their ids.

Claims also cover the copy and journey hand-off values the constants in the read list hold for the add, transporter and journey pages, flagged in their notes as asserted by parts 13 and 14.
